exposure: compound heterozygous variants in the ROBO1 gene
outcome: thinning of the anterior commissure and corpus callosum
absence of the transverse pontine fibers
corticospinal tracts and medial lemnisci not clearly separated from each other
cohort: A single boy with a novel neurodevelopmental disorder was described.
finding: Compound heterozygous variants in the ROBO1 gene are implicated in a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by a specific neuroimaging phenotype including absence of transverse pontine fibers and thinning of the anterior commissure and corpus callosum.
